# New fixed order-calibration experiment

This is a new experiment, not a reinterpretation or rescue of the failed global level sweep. Production PR6 stays3f71d03f3297f94e8c2cc34160262a880be337fc; stock1.3.2 and the unchanged PR6 vendored ng snapshot (upstream pin88601f0bdd192e9f87d4bd0a50d5d2e2dc9b8cd0) retain all215 expected hashes. No level mapping, strategy, allocator configuration, source/default or PR6 edit. Java requested1 continues to select physical ng2. Default internal allocations are not hooked.

## Predeclared layout and sample budget

Eight resident worker processes run serially on the same fixed CPU. The fixed calibration layout order is0,7,3,4,5,2,6,1; each factor has equal mean chronological position in its0/1 strata, with six loading-order reversals. Conditional tiny execution uses the reverse order1,6,2,5,4,3,7,0. This reduces a linear time trend confound and does not establish the absence of other drift. Layout bits independently reverse (1) loading all four images, (2) assigning logical backends to physical stream/output-buffer slots, and (3) setup initialization and priming order. Stock A/B are literal byte-identical ELF copies on different inodes; ng A/B likewise, using the same private prefix. Exact-handle RTLD_LOCAL lookup, -Bsymbolic, different mapped A/B bases and actual function addresses are checked/logged. Device/inode, full process maps, z_stream/output/input-buffer pointers, setup state addresses/creation ordinals, last warm state, and every batch's actual first/last state and initialization ordinal are retained. State summaries and image/slot address summaries are exported. A slot is the stream/buffer configuration together, not heap placement alone.

Initial calibration:4 physical configurations (stock6, ng6, ng1 quick, ng2 fast) ×2 unchanged calibration inputs (the prior Java64 and mixed4096 exact hashes) ×raw/wrapped ×reset-only/reuse/create-end ×3 controls ×8 layouts =1152 cells. Each cell has12 chronological blocks ×20 balanced alternating pairs ×128 operations/arm. Exactly552960 rows /276480 pairs. Every layout runs once even if an earlier control fails. No cell is dropped and no offset is subtracted.

Controls are shared-code/shared-stream; same-image/two-states; and separate byte-identical images/two-states. The first two select A/B copies by a fixed balanced load-bit XOR slot-bit, and the shared stream uses the selected physical slot. Same-image two-state logical assignments additionally reverse by block; separate-image arms keep logical image A/B identity while slot and initialization orders reverse between layouts. These assignments are encoded in the complete manifest and audited from every row.

The criterion is unchanged: every initial A/A cell must have abs(mean of12 block paired differences)+2.201×SEM≤100ns. Every nonshared control must additionally meet the same bound for fixed physical-slot1-minus-slot0. Raw/wrapped, each mode, configuration, input and layout remain separate required gates. No averaging away a failing layout, posthoc exclusions, threshold changes, prior offsets or retry-until-pass. CPU time, faults, context switches and available throttle counters are retained without exclusions; unavailable cpu.max is not evidence of no quota.

Loading reversals and image/slot/initial-order strata provide an identification matrix. Actual images and state pointers remain authoritative. For reset/reuse, later initialization is independently reversed while states remain alive for each block. For create/end, each measured call creates/ends its own stream: actual creation order necessarily coincides with batch execution order. The separately reversed setup/priming order probes allocator history; it does not pretend to identify creation order independently of execution order. Both order strata and actual ordinals are retained. Image/slot/creation-associated patterns can be reported; sole physical causes are not presumed. Balanced image-identity, later-loaded, higher-function-address, physical-slot and later-created association means are declared descriptive outputs. They never cancel a failed per-cell100ns bound or change qualification.

## Strict conditional tiny phase

After calibration each worker blocks, keeping loaded images resident. The coordinator waits until all eight have completed; if any gate fails, it sends STOP to all and executes no tiny compression or timed comparison. Otherwise it sends GO serially to each worker. No image reload or calibration-driven source/layout selection occurs.

All comparison cases are declared before calibration:32/64/128-byte WHOLE inputs across original Java/HotSpot/documentation prefixes, repeated-A, fresh text, valid fresh JSON strings, fresh deterministic SHAKE256 bytes and fresh mixed patterns. Fresh cases rotate a bank of32 distinct byte arrays, in exactly the same sequence in both arms. This means a fixed diverse bank, not infinitely never-before-seen inputs. There are24 tiny cases /396 tiny payloads, plus2 calibration payloads. No first chunk is treated as total stream size; no Java mapping/constructor or ZIP/GZIP streaming policy is changed.

Six direct contrasts:stock6-v-ng6, stock6-v-ng1, stock6-v-ng2, ng6-v-ng1, ng6-v-ng2, ng2-v-ng1. Both raw/wrapped and reset+FINISH reuse versus fresh init+FINISH+end are separate. Each contrast runs with all-A and all-B image copies in every layout. Per cell6 blocks ×6 balanced pairs ×32 operations/arm. Exactly9216 comparison cells /663552 rows. A repeated-byte create/end tie or ng1 loss is retained; universal stock6 superiority is not assumed.

Each worker then executes a fixed post bracket identical to its initial calibration matrix:another1152 cells /552960 rows globally. Every conditional comparison and post bracket executes once if the initial gate passes, regardless of later post results. Any post failure disqualifies ALL tiny timing. Maximum whole campaign:11520 cells /1769472 rows /884736 pairs. The outer safety deadline is40min plus build/artifact handling within a45min core job; expiration is a failure, not permission to reduce samples or retry.

Every calibration configuration and image copy is stock-inflated before calibration. Tiny untimed correctness runs only after GO. Every tiny bank/configuration/image/raw-wrapped combination is inflated and byte-compared; A/B compressed bytes must match exactly. Each measured batch's total compressed bytes and final length are checked, and each physical state's representative final output per block is inflated outside timing. Not every timed operation is inflated. Output bytes, hashes, deltas and ratios versus stock6 AND ng6 are retained per bank; raw DEFLATE bytes must equal wrapped[2:-4] with exactly6 wrapper bytes.

## Artifacts and execution boundary

The complete fixture/schedule manifest, source hashes and fixed criterion are written before execution. A STARTED marker prevents accidental second execution in the same output directory. Source, binaries, Makefiles/configure/compile logs, default flags, environment, raw rows, address logs, all scores/order strata and size outputs are uploaded even when calibration fails. Four predefined read-only export jobs split compact scored evidence into bounded logs; they never execute a measurement. Raw rows/maps and complete binary artifacts remain in the official ZIP. No later evidence-reader publication is required by this design.

`order-study.py --root CHECKOUT --corpora PINNED_CORPUS_CHECKOUT --out OUTPUT` prepares and executes once. `--prepare-only` compiles and declares fixtures/schedule. `--untimed-only` performs correctness checks with NO calibration/comparison timing; use a separate local output folder. Neither local correctness success nor a passing individual control rescues an earlier failed experiment.
